review.features: Goesan Gakyeonsa Daeungjeon: SINGLE storey, three front bays with four broad red wooden columns, sage-green lattice doors with small pale lower painted panels, broad low gray HIP-AND-GABLE tiled roof, muted green-red brackets, pale rough stone plinth, short centered stone steps, close wooded green hillside behind and sandy courtyard. No outdoor Buddha, cave, cliff carving or stream. View slightly from front-right so short gable end is visible.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

review.features: 장식 없는 원통형 철당간·지주, 숲. 장식 보주와 돌출 원판을 제거해 수정.
review.basis: 기존 확인 철당간 자료와 공식 대웅전 형태 참고

review.features: 관봉 석조여래좌상·얇고 평평한 판석 관·긴 얼굴·배후 화강암과 팔공산 산세. 목포 갓바위와 혼동하지 않음.
review.basis: 대구광역시 제공 공식 관광 사진을 별도로 열람해 형태만 확인. 사진을 생성 도구에 제공하지 않고 텍스트로 제작. 둥근 버섯형 관으로 생성된 초기 시안은 제외.

review.features: 단층 팔작지붕 대웅전·녹색 살문·축대·앞 석탑
review.basis: 공유마당 제공 대웅전 건축 자료의 형태를 별도로 확인

review.features: 대웅전 팔작지붕·삼칸 살문과 우금암 바위산의 상징
review.basis: 기존 확인 건축 형태·사찰 지형 설명. 앞마당 강·연못을 넣지 않음

review.features: 능파교 단일 석조 홍예·낮은 석재 난간·계류
review.basis: 기존 확인 능파교 형태. 허구의 큰 석탑·폐허 제외

review.features: 대웅보전 팔작지붕의 측면 합각·단층 전각과 산자락
review.basis: 기존 확인 대웅보전 구조. 산불 이후 전체 배치의 임의 복원은 하지 않음

name: 골굴사
reviewedFeatures: Golgulsa rock-carved seated Buddha: a large serene broad face in a weathered pale gray cliff niche, high head topknot, curling flame-like halo carved into the rock around shoulders, draped garment lines descending to a cross-legged seated base, natural uneven rock continues below. A sculptural rock face, not a free-standing statue, no fabricated cave buildings.

reference.title: 경주 골굴암 마애여래좌상
reference.description: 경상북도 경주시 양북면 안동리 골굴암에 있는 통일신라시대의 불상. 높이 4m. 보물 제581호. 암벽에 있는 자연굴을 이용하여 조성한 12개의 석굴 중 가장 윗 부분에 마애불이 새겨져 있다.

review.features: Changnyeong Gwallyongsa Daeungjeon: compact SINGLE-storey three-bay hall, gray HIP-AND-GABLE tile roof, wide gently lifted eaves, faded jade-green brackets and lattice doors between dark red posts, pale stone terrace. Distinctive real jagged gray granite Byeongpung-bawi ridge rises BEHIND the hall; low adjoining tiled-roof wings at sides, rough sandy courtyard, a broad circular weathered stone base in foreground. No giant Buddha head carved into ridge, no cave shrine, no river. 병풍바위는 독립된 뾰족 봉우리 대신 연속된 암벽 능선으로 수정.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

review.features: 제주 한라산 숲·현무암 돌길·낮은 사찰 전각
review.basis: 제주 관음사의 지역·자연환경과 기존 확인 자료. 내륙 암벽·대형 누각 제외

name: 관촉사
reviewedFeatures: Gwanchoksa stone lantern: squat rounded stone shaft on a wide base; a very broad lower square roof with upward turned corners over a tall open four-post light chamber; a second smaller square roof and shallow upper chamber, crowned by a compact peach-shaped stone finial. Two roof levels total. Focus this unusual stone lantern, muted woodland background, do not add a giant Buddha or other monuments.

reference.title: 논산 관촉사 석등 후측면
reference.description: 논산에 위치한 968년에 제작된 것으로 추정되는 관촉사 석등의 후측면 모습이다. 2014년 이전 촬영.

name: 구인사
reviewedFeatures: Guinsa at Danyang: large dark-gray Korean tiled lecture-hall roofs above a long multi-level modern hall block with horizontal balconies and pale terrace railings, rising on a steep forested valley slope. Several taller dark timber halls are layered behind it. Convey the distinctive vertically terraced, densely built mountain site, no free-standing pagoda and no Chinese-style needle roofs.

reference.title: 구인사
reference.description: 충북 단양군 영춘면 백자리 소백산에 있는 절. 대한불교 천태종의 총본산이다.

name: 기림사
reviewedFeatures: Girimsa Eungjinjeon: a broad single-story five-bay timber Buddhist hall with a straight-ridged side-gabled roof, exposed pale weathered wooden gable at the right, white plaster panels separated by dark brown timber, restrained green brackets, on a low stone foundation in a sandy quiet courtyard. The main roof must be gabled, not hipped or multi-story.

reference.title: 기림사 응진전
reference.description: 경북 경주시 양북면 호암리 기림사에 있는 조선 후기의 불전. 정면 5칸, 측면 2칸의 다포계 단층 겹처마 맞배지붕 건물. 경상북도 유형문화재 제214호.

name: 김룡사
reviewedFeatures: Gimryongsa viewed across a wooded slope: a compact cluster of modest gray tiled Korean halls around pale earthen courtyards in a broad, densely forested green mountain hollow. Keep the buildings relatively small within the forest; low gabled and hipped roofs recede toward the valley. Not a grand palace, no pagoda or statue invented.

reference.title: 김룡사
reference.description: 경북 문경시 산북면 김룡리 운달산에 있는 절. 588년(진평왕 10) 조사 운달이 운봉사라 이름하여 창건했으며, 민족항일기에는 전국 31본사의 하나로서 50개의 말사를 거느린 큰 절이었으나, 지금은 교통의 불편으로 옛 말사였던 직지사의 말사가 되었다.

review.features: Naksansa Hongyemun: a LONG LOW stone-block wall with ONE rounded central arch passage; a small open THREE-bay Korean timber pavilion stands directly above arch, ONE dark gray hip-and-gable tile roof, four plain wooden posts, no enclosed second roof. Pine trees behind, sandy footpath through arch. Depict this real gate closely, not a seaside Guan-yin fantasy scene.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 내소사
reviewedFeatures: Naesosa Seolseondang and dormitory buildings: low L-shaped weathered timber buildings with plain triangular side gables, white plaster between dark wooden posts, uneven stone retaining foundation and simple stone steps, open courtyard shaded by one mature broadleaf tree. Focus the austere daily-living architecture rather than a richly painted main sanctuary.

reference.title: 부안 내소사 설선당과 요사 정면
reference.description: 부안에 위치한 내소사 건물 중 설선당과 요사의 정면 모습이다. 1996년 촬영.

name: 다솔사
reviewedFeatures: Dasolsa Boanam stone hermitage grotto: a low rounded mound built of many irregular flat gray stones, covered lightly in moss, with a small rectangular dark entrance framed by two stone jambs and a flat lintel. Stone bowls and low loose stone steps lie near the doorway. Dense woodland behind. No Buddha added and no huge natural cavern.

reference.title: 사천 다솔사 보안암 석굴 정측면
reference.description: 사천 다솔사 보안암에 위치한 보안암 석굴의 정측면 모습이다. 1987년 촬영.

name: 대승사
reviewedFeatures: Daeseungsa at Mungyeong in light winter snow: low dark tiled timber halls around two levels of courtyards at the foot of a gentle wooded ridge, a modest roofed entry building near the foreground and a central main hall on the upper terrace. A few pine branches at the frame, restrained snow patches. No towering pagoda or immense palace.

reference.title: 문경 대승사
reference.description: 문경 대승사(ⓒ 한국학중앙연구원/유남해, 2014).

name: 대원사
reviewedFeatures: Sancheong Daewonsa in a Jirisan valley: a broad dark tiled hipped-and-gabled Korean hall on a stone terrace with red wooden pillars and green painted brackets, adjacent low gray roofs receding diagonally through bare early-spring trees, gentle forested mountain slopes behind. Keep a compact mountainside temple arrangement, no ocean, no added monumental statue.

name: 대조사
reviewedFeatures: Daejosa at Buyeo: a modest brown-and-ochre Korean timber hall with dark gray hipped-and-gabled roof above rough stone footings under a massive old leafy tree, a simple slender three-story stone pagoda to one side of the sandy courtyard. Focus the shaded hall and its actual stone-tower relationship; no invented giant statue outside the described view.

reference.title: 부여 대조사
reference.description: 충남 부여군 임천면 구교리 성흥산에 있는 절. 대한불교조계종 제6교구 본사인 마곡사의 말사이다.

name: 도갑사
reviewedFeatures: Dogapsa Daeungbojeon: an imposing TWO-STORY wooden hall with two broad dark-gray tiled hipped-and-gabled roof tiers, red timber pillars, green painted brackets and pale lattice doors, raised on a broad stone terrace. An open uncluttered courtyard and a smaller single-story hall to the left, rounded forest hills behind. No three-story palace roof or added pagodas.

reference.title: 영암 도갑사 대웅보전 전경
reference.description: 2015년 촬영한 도갑사 대웅보전의 모습이다.

name: 도리사
reviewedFeatures: Dorisa Taejo Seonwon courtyard: low gray tiled Korean wooden halls arranged around a small irregular earthen courtyard under mature leafy shade trees; a central rear hall with a hipped-and-gabled roof and side-gabled white-plaster side wings on rough stone terraces. Intimate forested setting, no stone tower or extra statue.

reference.title: 구미 도리사 중 태조선원 일원
reference.description: 구미에 위치한 도리사 중 태조선원 일원이다. 1997년 이전 촬영.

name: 도선사
reviewedFeatures: Doseonsa Hoguk Chamhoe Won area: a Korean wooden hall with a broad dark tiled hipped-and-gabled roof, colorful green/red/blue timber brackets and an elevated veranda above a pale stone lower terrace. Viewed diagonally from a wooded hillside with thick green forest behind. A compact complex, not a free-standing tall pagoda and not a Buddhist cave.

reference.title: 서울 도선사 중 호국참회원 일원
reference.description: 서울에 위치한 도선사 중 호국참회원 일원이다. 1988년 이전 촬영.

name: 도피안사
reviewedFeatures: Dopian sa at Cheorwon: a low single-story timber main hall with straight side-gabled roof and pale plaster between dark posts at the back of a small courtyard; in front to one side a modest three-story gray stone pagoda on a broad rounded stone base. Pine and bare early-spring trees frame the low hill behind. No multi-story timber hall.

reference.title: 철원 도피안사
reference.description: 강원 철원군 동송읍 관우리 화개산에 있는 절. 865년(경문왕 5)에 도선이 향도 1,000명과 함께 이 절을 창건하였다. 보물 제223호인 삼층석탑과 국보 제63호인 철조비로자나불좌상이 있다.

name: 동학사
reviewedFeatures: Donghaksa mountain precinct: a close grouping of gray tiled wooden hall roofs at different courtyard levels in a steep green valley, with a single-story sanctuary with dark wood and pale walls at the far center. The skyline is a broad jagged forested Gyeryongsan ridge, not isolated alpine spires. No large modern buildings or imaginary pagodas.

reference.title: 공주 동학사 일원
reference.description: 공주에 위치한 동학사 일원이다. 1984년 이전 촬영.

review.features: Daegu Donghwasa Daeungjeon: front view of a broad THREE-bay SINGLE-storey hall, four dark red timber columns, muted sage lattice doors, dense faded dancheong brackets, broad dark gray hip-and-gable tiled roof with slightly lifted eaves. Low pale stone terrace and short centered granite steps, intimate wooded hillside. No giant Buddha, no craggy mountain pinnacles.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 만어사
reviewedFeatures: Maneosa: a compact gray tiled gabled timber hall on a rough stone terrace beside scattered natural boulders, a small three-story stone pagoda off to one side; quiet hillside woodland with a hint of autumn. The relationship of natural stones and modest temple courtyard is important, no sea or giant cliff statue.

reference.title: 밀양 만어사 경내 전경
reference.description: 1997년에 촬영한 밀양에 위치한 만어사의 경내 모습이다.

name: 무량사
reviewedFeatures: Muryangsa at Buyeo: tall TWO-STORY Geungnakjeon wooden hall with two layered dark-gray hipped-and-gabled roof tiers, yellow-brown plaster and dark red timber, seen through a frame of mature trees behind a spacious courtyard and low tiled foreground roofs. No three-story pagoda-like building, no invented ornate bridge.

reference.title: 부여 무량사
reference.description: 충남 부여군 외산면 만수리 만수산에 있는 신라시대의 절. 신라 말기 범일이 창건한 대한불교조계종 제6교구 본사인 마곡사의 말사로 조선시대 상당수의 경판이 간행되었다.

review.features: 기존 무위사 제014화 대표 수채화 재사용
review.basis: atlas/muwisa/CREDITS.html 및 기존 회차 검토 자료

review.features: Gochang Munsusa actual maple-forest approach: a quiet gently curving paved gray path under a dense tunnel of OLD MAPLE trees, simple low dark brown timber-post railing on the left, mossy ground, green foliage with only a few pale warm leaves. No cliff Buddha, no rock carvings, no invented temple hall, no river.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 미황사
reviewedFeatures: Mihwangsa at Haenam: modest gray tiled Korean halls on low stone terraces in a green valley directly beneath the distinctive long low wall of pale rocky Dalm a san ridge outcrops. The ridge is continuous and serrated, not snowy sharp alpine summits. The temple remains small against the rocky mountain background; no ocean inserted.

reference.title: 해남 미황사
reference.description: 해남 미황사(ⓒ 한국학중앙연구원/유남해, 2015).

name: 백담사
reviewedFeatures: Baekdamsa: low dark tiled temple halls around a pale curving courtyard in dense deep-green Seoraksan woodland, central courtyard trees and a row of modest hipped-and-gabled sanctuary roofs partly screened by foliage. Quiet close mountain-forest composition without tall modern towers or an invented giant waterfall.

reference.title: 인제 백담사
reference.description: 강원도 인제군 북면 용대2리 설악산에 있는 절. 대한불교조계종 제3교구 본사인 신흥사의 말사이다.

name: 백련사
reviewedFeatures: Gangjin Baengnyeonsa: a long weathered timber hall standing on an elevated rough-stone terrace, gray tiled roof and dark wooden lattice facade at the right, lower stone retaining walls and a few modest tiled wings stepping down left. Green wooded Mandeoksan ridge behind. An intimate sloping precinct, no tall pagoda or beach.

review.features: Baegyangsa Ssanggyeru with Baekhakbong: a small TWO-level Korean open timber pavilion beside a STILL POND, a SINGLE broad gray hip-and-gable tiled roof and simple visible wood railings. Its reflection below. A SINGLE broad pale-gray vertical limestone cliff face crowns a forested mountain behind, not multiple alpine spires. Soft green leaves, restrained blush/gold, no exaggerated autumn.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.
review.referenceTitle: File:장성 백양사 쌍계루와 백학봉 2019년 촬영(출처 문화재청 대변인실).jpg

review.features: Busan Beomeosa THREE-storey stone pagoda as focal landmark: simple pale gray square body, THREE flat wide thin roof stones that become smaller upward, compact small finial and two-tier square base. Behind it a cropped long LOW one-storey gray tiled hall with dark wood and pale wall panels; green Geumjeongsan wooded slope. No orange mountain cliffs, no five-storey pagoda.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 법화사
reviewedFeatures: Jeju Beophwasa heritage precinct: a broad single-story unpainted brown timber hall with a dark-gray hipped-and-gabled roof, repeated wooden lattice door bays and a low pale stone terrace, dark woodland behind and a spacious earthy front court. Restrained architecture, no painted Chinese palace or extra stone tower. This is an interpretive historic-reference view, not a live present-day reconstruction.

reference.title: 제주 법화사지
reference.description: 제주에 위치한 법화사지의 모습이다. 1989년 이전 촬영.

name: 법흥사
reviewedFeatures: Beopheungsa at Yeongwol: a small mountain-temple courtyard with a single-story dark tiled hipped-and-gabled hall with red pillars at right and another modest gabled building at left, low irregular stone terrace walls and a woodland slope behind. Keep the simple low halls, no pagoda or mountain summit invented.

review.features: Hamyang Byeoksongsa THREE-storey stone pagoda: three graduated thin square roof stones, simple compact square body, small rounded finial, low double-tier square granite foundation, on a GRASSY gently sloping knoll. Rounded low forest hills, pine branches frame one side, tiny low temple roof at far edge only. No enormous pine trunk dominant, no stream, no added statue.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 보광사
reviewedFeatures: Paju Bogwangsa Daeungbojeon: a compact single-story Korean hall with a dark gray hipped-and-gabled roof, unusually dense layered weathered wooden brackets under wide eaves, faded red timber and subtle painted wall panels, three main lattice-door bays above a low stone terrace. Green Goryeongsan hillside behind. No Seoul cityscape and no extra monumental towers.

reference.title: 파주 보광사 대웅보전
reference.description: 경기도 파주시 광탄면 영장리에 있는 조선 후기의 사찰. 경기도 유형문화재 제83호.

name: 보리암
reviewedFeatures: Namhae Boriam: a small cluster of low gray-tiled hermitage roofs tucked closely beneath massive rounded golden-gray granite outcrops on a high mountain ridge, with distant blue layered coastal hills and a little pale atmospheric horizon. Emphasize the intimate architecture against huge natural boulders. Do not add a giant Buddha or fabricated suspension bridge.

review.features: Ganghwa Bomunsa stone chamber: a massive LOW natural pale granite rock slab forms the roof over THREE stone arched entry bays; carved pale stone columns at front, faded teal/blue doors within, a low straight stone terrace and broad steps. Green vegetation growing around and atop the rock. No sea cliffs, giant standing statue, pagoda, Korean tiled roof or fantasy cave palace.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 봉선사
reviewedFeatures: Bongseonsa at Namyangju: terraced Korean temple roofs under tall mature trees, a low broad roofed entrance hall in the foreground and a larger sanctuary with layered dark gray hipped-and-gabled roof above it, pale stone retaining walls and winter-bare branches with restrained snow remnants. No fictional tall pagoda or new palace complex.

reference.title: 남양주 봉선사
reference.description: 경기 남양주시 진접읍 부평리 운악산에 있는 고려 전기의 절. 대한불교조계종 제25교구 본사. 969년(광종 20)에 법인국사 탄 문이 창건하면서 운악사라 하였고, 1469년(예종 1)에 중창 뒤 봉선사라고 하였다.

name: 봉암사
reviewedFeatures: Bongamsa at Mungyeong: a restrained low temple compound at the foot of a dense green wooded slope, long side-gabled dormitory wings at left, a small central roofed gateway, and a taller single-story hipped-and-gabled sanctuary behind around a pale courtyard. The mood is austere and monastic, no large towers or decorative flowers.

reference.title: 문경 봉암사
reference.description: 경북 문경시 가은읍 원북리 희양산에 있는 절. 대한불교조계종 제8교구 본사인 직지사의 말사이다.

name: 봉원사
reviewedFeatures: Bongwonsa in Seoul: two modest dark tiled wooden halls on separate stone terrace levels around an irregular open courtyard, broad gray hipped-and-gabled roofs and warm dark-red timber, a wooded slope behind. Omit temporary tents, wires, banners and visitors; do not add any unobserved monuments. New quiet side-angle composition.

reference.title: 봉원사
reference.description: 불교의 한 종단. 우리 나라 불교 18개 종단 중의 하나이다. 봉원사는 서울 서대문구 봉원동 안산에 있는 절로 한국불교 태고종의 총본산이다.

name: 봉은사
reviewedFeatures: Bongeunsa Myeongbujeon interior: focus the actual richly painted green-red Korean timber beams, layered brackets and coffer-like ceiling above a side altar, with a softly rendered small gilded robed bodhisattva figure in the background. An intimate indoor architecture study, no free-standing pagoda and no invented additional deity portraits. No lettering or visitors.

reference.title: 봉은사 명부전
reference.description: 저승의 유명계를 상징하는 사찰 당우 중 하나. 서울 강남구 삼성동의 봉은사 명부전.

review.features: Andong Bongjeongsa Daeungjeon: weathered mostly BROWN TIMBER hall, SINGLE storey, THREE front bays with dark brown lattice doors, broad gray HIP-AND-GABLE roof, restrained faded brackets, prominent rough stone retaining terrace and a short central stair. A lower tiled-roof wing cropped at left, an overhanging eave cropped at upper right frames the courtyard. Quiet deciduous trees. Not a green-red palace, not a multi-storey tower.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 봉정암
reason: 정확한 소재지와 대표 요소를 확인할 사용 가능 참고 사진 미확보

name: 불갑사
reviewedFeatures: Bulgapsa wooden triad: THREE seated gilded Buddhist figures side by side on a red-and-green painted wooden altar below a modest timber canopy, central figure with right hand lowered toward knee and left hand at lap, flanking figures at similar scale. Warm ochre wall behind, restrained watercolor detail, no extra Buddha rows or text.

reference.title: 영광 불갑사 목조석가여래삼불좌상
reference.description: 전라남도 영광군 불갑면 모악리 불갑사에 대웅전에 봉안된 3구의 불상으로, 중앙의 석가모니불을 중심으로 왼쪽에 약사불, 오른쪽에 아미타불이 자리하고 있다. 보물 제1377호.

review.features: 서쪽 간결한 삼층 석가탑·동쪽 다보탑의 계단·기둥·팔각부
review.basis: 기존 확인 두 탑의 실제 구조. 새 대표 그림은 텍스트 지시로 제작

review.features: Uljin Buryeongsa Daeungbojeon: SINGLE-storey THREE-bay hall with very broad dark gray HIP-AND-GABLE tile roof, densely carved green-red brackets under deep eaves, dark green lattice doors and red posts, on a low pale stone plinth. A modest THREE-storey square stone pagoda centered in front, with two smaller distinct pale stone lanterns to either side. Wooded pine hillside behind, light gravel courtyard. No pond in this close hall view, no extra temple roofs stacked on building.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 산방굴사
reviewedFeatures: Sanbanggulsa in Jeju: a natural dark gray volcanic rock grotto with a pale seated Buddha on a low stone-block altar, a few small simple candle lights and rough uneven rock walls descending toward the entry at one side. The grotto is shallow and intimate, no vast constructed stone dome, no temple buildings inside and no visitors.

reference.title: 산방굴사
reference.description: 제주도 남제주군 안덕면 산방산에 있는 석굴. 고려말에 고승 혜일이 수도하던 곳이다.

name: 삼광사
reason: 동명 장소의 소재지 또는 대표 산세를 확인할 수 있는 사용 가능 참고 사진 부족

name: 상원사
reviewedFeatures: Pyeongchang Sangwonsa: a single-story vividly painted Korean hall with a broad dark-gray hipped-and-gabled roof, red columns and pale lattice windows, raised on a clean pale stone terrace with railings and two short stone stairways, woodland mountain slope behind. Do not add extra roof tiers or big pagodas.

reference.title: 평창 상원사
reference.description: 강원 평창군 진부면 동산리 오대산에 있는 상원사의 선원. 청량선원이라고 하며, 선원 안에는 석가여래좌상과 문수보살상, 국보 제221호로 지정된 목각문수동자상, 3구의 소형 동자상, 서대에서 이곳으로 옮겨온 목각의 대세지보살상이 함께 봉안되어 있다.

review.features: Seokguram actual granite chamber concept: ONE pale gray granite seated Buddha on a ROUND lotus stone pedestal, right hand lowered over right knee, left hand resting in lap; a plain circular carved halo behind head. Rounded granite DOME with subtle block joints above, rectangular stone entry pillars and restrained bas-relief guardian panels on chamber walls. Keep stone pale gray/ivory, not gold. No gilded palace, multiple Buddhas or invented tall arch corridors. Peaceful, accurate Korean stone grotto silhouette.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.
review.referenceTitle: File:Front view of Seokguram from front chamber.jpg

review.features: Suncheon Songgwangsa Daeungjeon: very WIDE SINGLE-storey FIVE-bay hall with six red posts, alternating sage lattice door groups and pale open folding doors, broad sweeping dark gray HIP-AND-GABLE roof, complex muted green brackets. Pale granite terrace with THREE short adjacent center stair flights, low tiled wings behind and a softly wooded hill. No giant tree trunks or invented cliff.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 수덕사
reviewedFeatures: Sudeoksa at Yesan: the central old Daeungjeon has a SIMPLE SIDE-GABLED roof, dark natural timber and ochre wall panels; lower gabled halls frame a broad quiet courtyard against a gentle wooded Deoksungsan slope. Slight distant approach view, no hipped central roof, giant towers or invented stone bridge.

reference.title: 예산 수덕사
reference.description: 충남 예산군 덕산면 사천리 덕숭산에 있는 절. 대한불교조계종 제7교구 본사로 충남 일원의 36개 말사를 관장하고 있다.백제말에 숭제법사에 의하여 창건되었다고 하며,우리나라 4대 총림의 하나인 덕숭총림이 있다.

name: 수종사
reviewedFeatures: Sujongsa at Namyangju: small weathered timber gabled buildings tucked along a narrow stepped mountain terrace, low rough stone retaining walls, simple stone stairs and mature trees above, gray tiled roofs receding toward forest. No huge pagoda or sprawling palace. Emphasize the intimate hillside ascent.

review.features: Yeoju Silleuksa multi-storey BRICK pagoda: narrow tapering RECTANGULAR pale gray weathered BRICK tower with SIX visible diminishing block-like tiers, each divided by a very shallow projecting brick cornice, NOT broad sloped stone pagoda roofs. Small rounded finial on stepped square top, broad granite multi-step pyramidal base, trees closely frame the tower. No Chinese curly eaves, no stone three-storey temple pagoda.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 신원사
reviewedFeatures: Sinwonsa at Gongju: low single-story gray tiled Korean halls around an open stone-edged courtyard, modest wooden gateway/pavilion to one side, several sparse bare deciduous trees and a rounded low green mountain ridge behind. Restrained early spring view, no tall tower or invented lake.

reference.title: 신원사
reference.description: 충남 공주시 계룡면 양화리 계룡산에 있는 절. 651년(의자왕 11)에 보덕이 창건하였고 신라말에 도선이 법당만 남아 있던 절을 중창하였다. 계룡산 동서남북 4대사찰 중 남사에 속하며, 현존하는 당우로는 대웅전, 향각, 영원전, 대방, 요사채 등이 있고 문화재로는 충청남도유형문화재 제31호인 오층석탑과 부도가 있다.

name: 신흥사
reviewedFeatures: Sinheungsa at Sokcho: a compact complex of gray-tiled halls and pale courtyards nestled deep in a forested Seoraksan valley, long low roofs receding into dense dark-green slopes and distant serrated low ridge contours. Aerial-oblique valley view, no giant statue added to this observed precinct view.

reference.title: 속초 신흥사
reference.description: 강원도 속초시 설악동 설악산에 있는 절. 강원도 문화재자료 제7호.

name: 실상사
reviewedFeatures: Silsangsa at Namwon: a small low-roofed rural temple compound in a flat basin surrounded by rectangular irrigated rice paddies, a fringe of mature trees around the halls, pale paddy water reflecting the sky and distant soft hills. The temple is small within the open agricultural landscape, not a steep mountain monastery. No big invented tower.

reference.title: 남원 실상사
reference.description: 전라북도 남원시 산내면 입석리 지리산 천황봉에 있는 절. 사적 제309호.

name: 쌍계사
reviewedFeatures: Hadong Ssanggyesa Iljumun: a narrow single-bay wooden gate with red columns and one elegant gray tiled hipped-and-gabled roof, dense green-red brackets under the eaves, stepping stone approach and low stone balustrade, woodland behind. Remove lettering and banners; no enclosing wall or giant pagoda added.

name: 쌍봉사
reviewedFeatures: Ssangbongsa at Hwasun: focus the distinctive tall three-level wooden Daeungjeon with THREE stacked roofs rising above a square-ish footprint, red timber, green brackets, with a low tiled side wing and rounded green hill behind. This tower-like timber hall, not a stone pagoda, is the defining subject. No fourth roof tier.

name: 약천사
reason: 정확한 소재지와 대표 요소를 확인할 사용 가능 참고 사진 미확보

name: 연곡사
reviewedFeatures: Yeongoksa north monk stupa carving: close view of weathered pale granite relief of an ornamental ritual vase with swelling body, petal-like floral detail above and curling cloud/lotus motifs around a rectangular carved field. Focus the actual carved stone surface and its tactile relief, not an invented complete tower or temple facade.

reference.title: 구례 연곡사 북 승탑 중 탑신 문양
reference.description: 고려 후기 세워진 구례 연곡사 북 승탑 중 탑신 문양이다. 2009년 촬영.

name: 오어사
reviewedFeatures: Oeosa at Pohang: a compact group of low dark-gray tiled wooden halls directly above a narrow wooded reservoir shoreline, the green hill rising behind and calm blue-green water curving across the foreground. The temple is intimate against dense foliage; no offshore island, ocean waves or invented bridges.

review.features: Goseong Okcheonsa Daeungjeon: small but deep-eaved SINGLE-storey THREE-bay Korean hall on a HIGH roughly squared stone terrace, a STRAIGHT centered granite stair of about ten steps, red columns, muted jade brackets, gray HIP-AND-GABLE roof. Central doorway dark and open, pale side door panels. Dark green wooded hillside directly behind; lower tiled wings cropped at both sides enclose courtyard. No creek, no waterfall, no extra Buddha.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

review.features: Wanju Songgwangsa bell pavilion INTERIOR: a large dark bronze hanging temple bell centered between thick dark-red timber posts, layered sage-green and faded red wooden bracket sets and a dense timber beam grid above; pale stone floor and a partial view of quiet green courtyard at side. This is an interior view of the real Jongru bell structure, not an invented external pavilion form. No extra towers or statues.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

review.features: Yangpyeong Yongmunsa ancient GINKGO TREE: one MASSIVE gnarled gray trunk with a single broad base, branches dividing HIGH above ground into a tall irregular spreading crown. Small dark stone edging at its root mound, gentle sage and pale-gold fan-shaped foliage, only a very small gray tiled roof far behind. Tree is the clear landmark, not a grove of separate trunks. No river, no alpine cliffs.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

review.features: 삼칸 전면·단층 맞배지붕·격자문·석축 계단. 팔작처럼 생성된 지붕을 맞배지붕으로 수정해 재검토.
review.basis: 공식 출처의 해당 전각 사진을 별도 열람해 형태 확인. 생성 도구에 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트로 원화 제작·수정.

name: 운문사
reviewedFeatures: Unmunsa at Cheongdo: a spacious low temple compound with several rectangular pale courtyards, rows of modest gray tiled side-gabled dormitories and a central hipped-and-gabled hall at the foot of a broad wooded mountain bowl. Early spring colors, small scale roof rhythms, no massive modern towers.

name: 원당사
reason: 정확한 소재지와 대표 요소를 확인할 사용 가능 참고 사진 미확보

name: 월정사
reviewedFeatures: Woljeongsa at Pyeongchang: a modest monastic precinct of gray-tiled Korean halls edged by dense forest, a hipped-and-gabled sanctuary to one side and low dormitory roofs receding around a courtyard. New side composition, no invented circular pagoda or mountain temple on a cliff. Do not add unobserved large monuments.

name: 은하사
reviewedFeatures: Eunhasa at Gimhae: low gray-tiled halls set deep in a broad green forested Sin eos an mountain hollow, the main compound small within the wooded terrain, a few low terrace roofs stepping along the valley. Peaceful wide landscape view, no enormous rocky needles or fictional multi-story pagoda.

reference.title: 김해 은하사
reference.description: 경남 김해시 삼방동 신어산에 있는 절. 대한불교조계종 제14교구 본사인 범어사의 말사이다. 서림사라고도 하며, 가락국의 김수로왕 때 장유화상이 창건하였다고 한다.

review.features: Yeongcheon Eunhaesa established principal hall SHORT GABLED END view: SINGLE-storey, three-bay end wall with four red columns, pale pink/ivory solid lower door panels, very dense green-red carved eave brackets, dark gray HIP-AND-GABLE roof with the RED TRIANGULAR GABLE visible centered ABOVE this short end. A lower long tiled wing on left and rocky green hillside on right, low pale stone platform and short center steps. No river, no long stairway through forest.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 자재암
reviewedFeatures: Jajaeam at Dongducheon: a small row of gray-tiled gabled wooden halls on a narrow stone terrace directly below a rugged wooded cliff, one little hillside shrine higher up near the rock, a pale walking court along the buildings. Close mountain-ledge setting, no giant statue or tall tower added.

reference.title: 동두천 자재암 전경
reference.description: 1989년 이전에 촬영한 자재암의 모습이다.

name: 장안사(부산)
reviewedFeatures: Jangansa at Busan Gijang: a compact small cluster of low Korean tiled wooden halls in a densely forested green valley, a modest roofed gate near the bottom of the approach and the main hipped-and-gabled hall tucked farther back. Keep the buildings secondary to the green hollow, no ocean or invented ornate bridge.

name: 전등사
reviewedFeatures: Jeondeungsa in Ganghwa: gray-tiled Korean sanctuary roofs spread modestly over a low wooded hill and enclosed pale courtyards, russet autumn woodland, aerial-oblique view from the hillside rather than a giant mountain setting. No big stone stupa or palatial gate invented; the temple stays small in the landscape.

name: 조계사
reviewedFeatures: Jogyesa in Seoul: a broad very large single-story Korean Buddhist hall with a dark gray hipped-and-gabled roof and a smaller foreground tiled hall, mature trees within a tight urban precinct, subdued mid-rise Seoul buildings beyond. Make the contrast between old timber roof and city skyline clear. No literal logos, signs, vehicles or banners.

reference.title: 조계사
reference.description: 서울 종로구 견지동에 소재한 절. 1941년 한국불교 총본산으로 조계종단이 설립된 곳이다. 대한불교조계종의 직할교구 본사이다.

name: 존자암
reviewedFeatures: Jonjaam temple-site archaeology in Jeju: low rows of irregular dark volcanic foundation stones on a grassy clearing, stepped stone outlines of former building platforms, scattered weathered rocks, dense green woodland and light mist behind. A heritage ruin study based on the recorded site, NOT a fabricated reconstructed temple. No roofed buildings or Buddha statues invented.

reference.title: 존자암지
reference.description: 제주 서귀포시 하원동에 있는 암자터. 제주도 기념물 제43호. 기록에 의하면 존자암은 효종 이전에 그 위치가 영실에서 대정지경으로 옮겨진 것이며, 지금의 존자암지는 17세기 중반 이전의 존자암의 터전이다.

review.features: Gimcheon Jikjisa Daeungjeon: wide SINGLE-storey FIVE-bay front, six dark weathered timber columns, FIVE groups of dusty blue-sage lattice doors, broad dark gray HIP-AND-GABLE roof with gently lifted eaves, deep shaded brackets. Low granite terrace, short central steps, low pale stone balustrade and one small stone lantern left, straight pine-covered hillside behind. No ranks of tiny stone Buddhas, no giant staircase, no invented pagoda.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

review.features: Gurye Cheoneunsa Geungnakbojeon: SINGLE-storey THREE-bay hall, broad gray HIP-AND-GABLE tiled roof with upturned ends, ornate sage brackets, four red columns, sage lattice doors either side of a central OPEN doorway with pale folded doors. Rectangular rough stone terrace, short centered stone staircase and STRAIGHT flat stone walkway toward viewer, sandy courtyard with a few low stones and grasses on right, low tiled wings on both sides and wooded hill. No lake or cherry-reflection scene.
review.basis: 공식 출처 사진은 별도로 형태 검토에만 열람. 제작 도구에는 사진을 제공하지 않고 텍스트 사양으로 새 그림 제작.

name: 청량사
reviewedFeatures: Cheongnyangsa at Bonghwa: a tiny cluster of low gray tiled halls nestled between large continuous layered brown-gray cliffs and rounded rocky green outcrops, thick vegetation coating the ravines. The architecture is very small against the impressive rocky mountain bowl, no isolated needle peaks or sky bridges.

reference.title: 봉화 청량사 전경
reference.description: 2010년 이전에 촬영한 봉화 청량산에 위치한 청량사의 모습이다.

name: 청암사
reviewedFeatures: Cheongamsa at Gimcheon: a compact three-bay Korean Daeungjeon with a single elegant dark-gray hipped-and-gabled roof, richly weathered layered brackets, red columns and pale lattice doors, above a rough stone platform reached by one central narrow stair. Pine trunks and lush forest behind, no extra roof tiers or monuments.

reference.title: 김천 청암사 대웅전 정면
reference.description: 김천에 위치한 청암사 건물 중 대웅전의 정면 모습이다. 2014년 촬영.
